skills.name: Moon Blessing
skills.description: Basic Attacks grant Attack Speed stacks.
skills.tips: Keep passive stacked on minions before engaging.

skills.name: Moon Arrow
skills.description: Splits basic attack into multi-target arrows.
skills.tips: Upgrading this provides massive late game AoE.

skills.name: Arrow of Eclipse
skills.tips: Main early game harass and farming tool.

skills.name: Hidden Moonlight
skills.description: Dispel control effects and enter concealment.
skills.tips: Use to escape assassin burst setups.

items.name: Corrosion Scythe
items.des: Basic Attacks slow targets and grant Attack Speed.

items.name: Swift Boots
items.des: Increases Attack Speed and Movement Speed.

items.name: Demon Hunter Sword
items.des: Basic Attacks deal current enemy HP as extra physical damage.

items.name: Golden Staff
items.des: Converts critical chance stats into raw attack speed.

items.name: Haas' Claws
items.des: Grants Physical Lifesteal and attack speed on critical strikes.

items.name: Malefic Roar
items.des: Boosts Physical Penetration to shred tanks.

builds.tips: Swift Boots are optional due to natural passives; Rapid Boots are ideal for repositioning in late fights.

synergy.name: Tigreal
synergy.tips: Pulls enemies together for multi-target sweeps.

countered_by.name: Hayabusa
countered_by.tips: Vulnerable to instant burst single assassins.

skills.name: Fearless
skills.description: Gains physical defense shields on spell hits.

skills.name: Attack Wave
skills.description: Send an earth-shaking shockwave slowing enemies.

builds.tips: Always build defense items like Athena's Shield or Antique Cuirass.

skills.name: Enemy's Bane
skills.description: Basic Attacks reduce enemy physical defense.

builds.tips: Build Blade of Despair and Hunter Strike for high burst damage.
